err_no_profiles: There are no saved model profiles. Create a profile first.
err_conflict: Model profiles changed. Reload and try again.
err_no_rollback: No model profile switch to roll back.
err_atomic_store: The database does not support atomic model profile updates.
err_id: Use a profile ID of up to 32 lowercase letters, digits, underscores or hyphens; rollback is reserved.
err_name: The profile name is required and must be at most {max} characters on one line.
err_description: The profile description must be at most {max} characters and contain no null characters.
err_config_dir: Profiles cannot change which Claude profile new main conversations start in.
err_launcher_missing: Provider {launcher} is no longer available. Restore it before switching or rolling back.
err_launcher_model: Provider {launcher} must have a default model.
err_tiers: A profile can have at most {max} tiers.
err_tier_speed: Invalid speed {speed} in tier {tier}. Speeds: standard, fast, ultrafast.
err_profiles: At most {max} model profiles are allowed.
err_role: Full access is required to change model profiles.
confirm_deactivate: Turn off the model profile {profile} and its presets. Current model settings will stay the same.
confirm_already_inactive: No model profile is active. Current model settings will stay the same.
confirm_clear: Delete all saved model profiles ({profiles}) and permanently remove all rollback points ({rollbacks}). Current model settings will stay the same.
err_active_profile_missing: the model profile in use ({profile}) no longer exists: switch to another with model_profile_switch, or leave tier out
err_no_active_profile: no model profile is in use: switch to one with model_profile_switch, or leave tier out
err_tier_not_found: the model profile in use ({profile}) has no tier {tier}; its tiers: {tiers}
err_tier_model: Tier {tier}: {model} is not a model ID. Start with a letter or digit, then use only letters, digits and . _ - / : @ [ ].
err_tier_description: The description of tier {tier} must be at most {max} characters on one line.
tier_core: The main chat's model when this profile was made: core design and implementation, review and hard problems.
tier_dev: The New Agent model when this profile was made: development, debugging and research.
err_tier_alias: Tier {tier}: {alias} cannot be an alias; it must be a tier name of its own form and not the name or alias of another tier.
err_forbidden_field: Model profiles cannot include credential or endpoint field {field}.
